content:
OpenAI has previewed more than 20 announcements for its DevDay 2026 event. The event will be live-streamed. You can see everything announced today below.

OpenAI event live stream

We expect the main announcement to be ChatGPT's response to SpaceXAI's Grok Bot and Meta's Muse, expanding on existing AI agent tools to attract a wider consumer base.

OpenAI already has similar functionality under the ChatGPT Work framework, but the presentation isn't as straightforward as Muse and Grok Bot.

In any case, you can watch the live stream when it kicks off on the hour. The event will begin at 10am Pacific / 1pm Eastern.

Dots, AI agents that run continuously

First up: dots. These are AI agents that run continuously, a new feature within ChatGPT.

ChatGPT Space

Next is a new feature called ChatGPT Space. This is a collaborative workspace where you can work with dots, manage pages and presentations, and handle real-time document updates.

GPT-6.1 Sol

Additionally, OpenAI has announced information about the release of a new GPT-6.1 Sol model.

OpenAI stated: "We're introducing GPT‑6.1 Sol, an upgrade to GPT‑6 Sol, delivering intelligence on agentic coding, computer use, and professional work nearly on par with GPT‑6 Astra, but at standard pricing of just one-fifth of Astra for input and output tokens."

"Cached input costs just $0.10 per million tokens—95% lower than standard input pricing, and 50% lower than GPT‑6 Sol's cached input pricing—giving developers more room to build and run powerful agents that reuse context across requests."

You can learn more about this new model here.

All new announcements

Announcements are still rolling in, and OpenAI's website has a complete summary of everything announced today, including a brand new $500 per month subscription plan and more, so check it out.
